text:
sre-oncall: Notifying channel: we're seeing elevated write errors to token-store in eu-central-1 since ~09:10 UTC. Short-lived 502/503 on token issuance for some hosted routes. Creating thread for updates. /cc @channel

ops-bot: [ALERT] token-store write error-rate > 2% (eu-central-1)

nora: I can see rapid increase in write retry logs and write queue depth. Pulling pod logs now.

ben: Pushed a config change to token-store at 08:58 that increased write_sync=true for durability. Rolling that back now to async to test.

platform-eng: Mitigations: 1) toggled write_sync -> false, 2) scaled token-store replicas +25% in eu-central-1, 3) enabled routing fallback to eu-west-1 for affected hosted endpoints.

nora: Log snippet: 
```
2026-01-17T09:11:05Z ERROR token-store: write deadline exceeded, retries=4
2026-01-17T09:11:06Z WARN queue: depth=14200 inflight=950
```

ben: Rollback commands used: `kubectl set env deployment/token-store WRITE_SYNC=false -n core-eu` then `kubectl rollout restart deployment/token-store -n core-eu`. Restart completed at 09:14 UTC.

platform-eng: Early results: write error rate dropped from 2.3% -> 0.6% within 6 minutes. Fallback traffic to eu-west-1 up ~800 rps. Still monitoring queue drain.

support: Customer impact: some hosted generation requests in eu-central saw intermittent failures and retries. No Dedicated customer reports yet. Drafting status page blurb.

sre-oncall: Root cause hypothesis: a conservative durability toggle made writes synchronous under burst, increasing latency and causing upstream timeouts. Next actions: 1) revert config permanently until we design safe sync path, 2) add preflight for WRITE_SYNC changes, 3) add a synthetic high-QPS write preflight test. Postmortem owner: @ben.

ben: Acknowledged. I'll own RCA and remediation. Target incident doc by EOD.

ops-bot: [LINKS] Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/token-store.md | Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/token-store-eu-central

sre-oncall: ETA to normal: 20-40 minutes for queues to drain and error rate to stabilize <0.5%. We'll close thread when that's met.
